label: Teltonika RUT145 (RS485)
description: Industrial router with RS485: 1x 100 Mbps WAN, 1x 100 Mbps LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the RUT145 datasheet: **1x WAN and 1x LAN, 10/100 Mbps**, with an **RS485** bus interface. RS485 rather than RS232 - a two-wire multi-drop bus for meters and inverters, so one router can front a whole chain of devices. The **RS485 port is recorded here rather than as an interface: the catalogue models network interfaces, and a serial bus is neither an Ethernet port nor a radio.
